The vbdb simplification stripped all uses of 'pid_output', leaving only the initialization and the conditional reassignment. When PIDTEMP=true, 'pid_output = 1' (line 11) is also a dead store (but that alarm isn't reported here). Presence condition simplifies to NOT PIDTEMP — correctly capturing when the line 19 assignment fires — but the underlying cause is simplification, not a real defect.
